ancient_tortoise_desc: A strange Cannon Tortoise whose cannon has a different shape from current Cannon Tortoises. Completely unknown, it seems to wander the desert protecting something.
aquadon_desc: Originally an amphibious mechanical beast from Planet Zi. It excels particularly in aquatic functions and is equipped with water intake/discharge tanks, granting it high-performance submarine capabilities.
barigator_desc: Capable of operating in rivers, swamps, and wetlands. It can ford rivers of moderate depth and continue to move underwater. It specializes in river-crossing operations and guerrilla warfare.
barrage_tortoise_desc: A Zoid evolved from the Ancient Tortoise thanks to Beacon's abilities. No other specimen like it is known to exist. It possesses a series of cannons powered by an internal energy source.
bear_fighter_desc: Clad in heavy armor with a powerful main cannon on its back. It can transition from a high-speed, stable four-legged artillery stance to an upright two-legged close-combat stance. In melee combat, it uses powerful claws and chest missiles to destroy enemies.
cannon_tortoise_desc: Using its hard, sturdy body, it is equipped with an assault cannon and primarily tasked with attacking fortresses and bunkers. However, its low ammo capacity and slow combat speed are notable drawbacks.
cannon_tortoise_bc_desc: Developed because the liquid-cooled charged particle beam cannon was insufficient for rear support firepower. The significant weight increase drastically reduced mobility, but long-range shooting ability and firepower were further improved. New shock absorbers were also installed to handle the increased recoil from cannon fire.
cannon_tortoise_os_desc: Also known as Cannon Tortoise (Opis Specification). It is the personal unit of one of the Four Heavenly Kings, Opis, a modified Cannon Tortoise with enhanced armor and weaponry.
command_wolf_desc: A land-only high-speed attack mech developed to counter the Imperial army's Saber Tiger-led high-speed mobile forces. The twin beam cannon turret on its back can detach and fly independently as an attack vehicle, providing aerial support fire and intelligence gathering. Its main weapon, the electromagnetic fangs, are highly effective for targeting enemy weak points in close combat. In addition to its excellent armament, it offers high stability at high speeds, and the cockpit's newly equipped display helps reduce pilot fatigue during operation.
command_wolf_desert_desc: A Command Wolf specialized for desert operations, adapted to camouflage among the sands and operate more efficiently under the scorching sun.
crablaster_desc: An attack Zoid of the crab type that specializes in combat on rocky terrain and coastlines. It immobilizes enemies with a special foam that melts their armor, then attacks with its giant pincers.
crosswinger_desc: A dragonfly-type attack Zoid that excels at low-altitude cross fighting. Capable of vertical takeoff and landing, and when multiple units gather, they can even airlift large Zoids. It also possesses excellent stealth capabilities.
dcsj_desc: DCS-J stands for 'Double Cannon Special - Jet'. A variant of the DCS with a significantly upgraded power plant to compensate for the mobility loss caused by the added cannons. Its black color scheme is distinctive. Due to poor balance and extreme difficulty to handle, only 7 units were produced before manufacturing was discontinued. Only those who hold the title of 'Leo Master' can pilot it.
dragon_horse_desc: A Zoid creature known as Dragon Horse, used in ancient times by the Dragon Cavalries.
elephantus_desc: Its thick, sturdy body was converted into a heavily armored land exploration vehicle. Equipped with large ear-shaped high-performance 3D radar. During the first conflicts, most units were destroyed by Imperial mechs. Afterwards, it was used as a training unit for pilot development.
elephantus_starter_desc: Strong and tough, but slow and hard to pilot. Only for the bravest.
garius_desc: Its mobility and combat capability were outstanding for its time (during the first conflicts). It excels at reconnaissance using its high cockpit.
garius_starter_desc: Simple and easy to control. Few offensive weapons, but if you take good care of him he will be unstoppable.
gator_desc: The Gator, with its distinctive ground-hugging style and various electronic devices, specializes in scouting and electronic warfare while also possessing considerable firepower. Using its VTOL (Virtual Torpedo Launching) System, it can temporarily exceed speeds of 200 km/h.
gator_radome_desc: A specially configured Gator designed for long-term solo operations in enemy territory for intelligence gathering. Its small-caliber Gatling beam cannon has been replaced with a 3D radar dome, and its dorsal fin serves as a heat-dissipation panel to prevent overheating. It is painted in a brown camouflage pattern for concealment in deserts and forests.
geruder_desc: Introduced as the Empire's main unit to replace the Malder. While the Malder had good mobility, its weak armor led to increasing attrition. To address this, the Geruder sacrificed some mobility to strengthen its armor and improve ballistic resistance and survivability. As a result, units equipped with this Zoid were always deployed to the front lines.
giraffsworder_desc: A Zoid Baratz unit that was excavated, researched, and revived after being lost for ages. Cross-compatibility of parts between models dramatically improved mass production. As such, it became a low-cost mass-production unit adaptable from civilian to military use.
glidoler_desc: Originally a mechanical bird. Its agile mobility was leveraged to convert it into a space exploration craft. It is used as a space reconnaissance unit for Republic mechs. During the first war, most units were destroyed by Imperial mechs.
glidoler_starter_desc: Fast and strong, but fragile in combat. For experienced pilots.
goliath_desc: A snail-type attack Zoid that could be considered a smaller version of the Malder. It endures attacks with its thick armor and serves as an armored vehicle capable of breaking through enemy lines with artillery fire.
gorgodos_desc: Originally a land mechanical beast from Planet Zi. Naturally docile in temperament. Its back panel's radar and jamming wave oscillator functions were enhanced, and it was converted into a land exploration vehicle.
grandmolar_desc: A mole-type attack Zoid developed for special operations. It freely burrows underground using its giant power arms and spin drill, then launches surprise attacks from directly beneath enemies.
gunbeetle_desc: A Zoid Baratz unit that was excavated, researched, and revived after being lost for ages. Cross-compatibility of parts between models dramatically improved mass production. As such, it became a low-cost mass-production unit adaptable from civilian to military use.
gurantula_desc: Originally a land mechanical beast from Planet Zi. Its lightweight body and freely moving legs were leveraged to convert it into a high-speed land exploration vehicle.
guysack_desc: Originally a creature about 80 cm long that lived in the desert. It was enlarged through biotechnology and converted into a bio-mechanical unit for ambush attacks using venom.
hammerrock_desc: A compact, lightweight, dedicated close-combat type. Developed based on the combat results and effectiveness of the Iron Kong, it was originally tasked with supporting large Zoids, but it is fully capable of independent operations as well.
helcat_desc: Thanks to the special structure of its legs, it can silently approach and attack enemies in grasslands and jungles. Its body exhaust ports are black-hole treated, making it difficult to detect by infrared sensors — truly a ninja of the forest.
helcat_stray_desc: A Helcat that outlived its usefulness to the military. Its wild instincts have been reactivated through sleeper technology, turning it feral with the sole objective of survival.
heldigunner_desc: An amphibious iguana-type Zoid deployed in the Guylos Empire's heavy artillery and tactical stealth units. It excels in mobility and is capable of solo guerrilla warfare. The long-range assault beam cannon on its back was developed for the western continent invasion. During the Second Intercontinental War, it was further modified for the decisive western continent battle. It is the most terrain-adapted unit in that conflict.
helldiver_desc: A shark-type attack Zoid that demonstrates great power in underwater combat. Equipped with high-performance sonar, it specializes in torpedo attacks. It can also engage in melee combat using the head cutter on its cranium. Extremely high in offensive power.
hidocker_desc: Originally a land mechanical beast from Planet Zi. Like a lizard, its body has regenerative capabilities. It was converted into an infantry armored vehicle by adding a control system and equipping it with small firearms.
hyperscissors_desc: A crayfish-type attack Zoid that fights primarily in rivers and swamps. It excels at guerrilla warfare thanks to its low profile, and its giant pincers can easily shear through steel.
iron_kong_desc: A combat mechanical beast developed exclusively for close combat. As its near-human body shape suggests, it demonstrates outstanding ability in melee fighting. It proved particularly effective in jungles and urban areas where heavy firearms are less useful.
malder_desc: The heaviest among the Empire's small mechs, making it difficult to form armored units with other mechs. It is primarily used for rear support and as a mobile bunker.
merda_desc: The core combat mechanical beast of the Imperial armored forces, known for its exceptional mobility. It has a high survival rate and is trusted by soldiers. Since normal walking has speed limitations and causes high pilot fatigue, VTOL (Virtual Torpedo Launching) nozzles enable hovering capability.
missile_tortoise_desc: The huge projectiles fired from this gun are in at least some cases cluster munitions that allow the Zoid to target multiple enemies in a single shot.
molga_desc: Developed for land combat. It has a distinctive style with a low profile and heavy armor. Its head is equipped with double the standard armor, making it highly effective in assault operations and ramming attacks. Primarily deployed to assault and special forces units, it serves at the vanguard of battle.
red_horn_desc: Developed by the late Zenebas Empire as an anti-Gojulas weapon. The core Zoid of the Imperial armored divisions, its heavy weaponry and armor earned it the nickname 'Moving Fortress.' Its signature tactic is a charging attack using the Crusher Horn on its head. The design allows for further development, resulting in many variants — including the Guylos Empire's Dark Horn. Widely deployed to guard and assault units, it produced many ace pilots.
redler_desc: An aerial combat dragon-type Zoid from the late Zenebas Empire. Its variable wings provide high maneuverability, enabling supersonic flight and vertical takeoff and landing. The variable laser blade equipped on its tail stabilizer slashes enemy units in passing. Its landing gear doubles as Strike Claws that prove effective in melee combat.
saber_tiger_desc: The Guylos Empire's version of the Saber Tiger originally developed by the Zenebas Empire during the Central Continent War. At the time, despite being a large Zoid, its top speed of 200 km/h terrified all Republic front-line soldiers. After losing the title of fastest large Zoid to the Shield Liger, the Saber Tiger received power plant upgrades and cooling system modifications by the Guylos Empire, raising its top speed to 240 km/h. Now reborn as the Saber Tiger, it deploys to the battlefield where its eternal rival, the Shield Liger, awaits.
saber_tiger_gs_desc: Also known as Saber Tiger (Gale Specification). The personal Saber Tiger AT of Gale, one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Phantom Knights. It is equipped with assault combat weaponry, features a modified leg shoulder armor shape, and has a white color scheme.
saber_tiger_rs_desc: Also known as Saber Tiger (Raven Specification). Raven's personal Saber Tiger with shoulder armor painted in a bluish-black (or purple) tone. Most artillery armaments have been removed except for ground-to-ground missile pods, anti-Zoid 30mm twin beam cannons, and anti-Zoid triple impact cannons, emphasizing close-combat capability over ranged firepower.
saradin_desc: An armadillo-type attack Zoid that serves as an armored vehicle. Its entire body is covered in special alloy and ultra-hard ceramics, giving it high defensive power but lacking in offensive capability. Its survival rate is excellent.
sea_batoras_desc: A horseshoe crab-type attack Zoid that specializes in underwater combat. It also possesses flight capability, and its curved flat body is difficult to detect by radar. It has thick armor and can engage in melee combat with its twin claws.
sea_panther_desc: Its body, protected by powerful weaponry and heavy armor, can operate freely even in deep sea. It is a versatile undersea tank capable of handling various operational missions as well as combat. Its armament includes the largest beam cannon in its class and a devastatingly powerful 12-tube missile launcher that can annihilate enemies in an instant.
shield_liger_desc: A lion-type Zoid developed by the Helic Republic during the Central Continent War to counter the Zenebas Empire's Saber Tiger. Running at a top speed of 250 km/h, its performance surpasses the Saber Tiger. Intercoolers placed throughout the body constantly cool the power plant, and all weapons are stored inside the body to improve aerodynamic characteristics. It was developed with various engineering designs to achieve high-speed combat. It is the Helic Republic's main Zoid.
sinker_desc: The first flying Zoid developed by the old Zenebas Empire. It is Planet Zi's only sea-air dual-purpose unit. This capability is the reason this otherwise dated machine still serves on the front lines today. Its ability to quickly transition from underwater to aerial combat poses a major threat to naval Zoids. However, its air combat capability is low, and it struggles against fighter-type Zoids.
spiker_desc: A land combat mechanical beast from Planet Zi. Its main weapon is the Hyper Saber with razor-sharp blades, and it is equipped with anti-air cannons and machine guns on its back. It excels at close combat in grassland environments.
stealth_viper_desc: With its low stance and uniquely elongated form that freely adapts to terrain, the Stealth Viper is an ambush expert. It silently lurks in deserts and forests, waiting for enemies to approach before striking with a single decisive blow. It is also well-equipped with anti-air armaments, making it the only ground Zoid feared by flying Zoids.
zatton_desc: Due to its emphasis on armor, its weight increased even more than the Geruder, drastically reducing its mobility. As a result, it is primarily used for rear support, transport, and reconnaissance.
